description: Embedded graph-first multi-model database (SQL + graph + vector + spatial) with a native Rust core and bindings for Python, Node, Go, Swift, Kotlin, and Dart/Flutter.
rules: Use db.execute(sql) for DDL/DML (CREATE, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) and db.query(sql) for SELECT and graph queries; the SQL surface is PostgreSQL-like.
Prefer parameterized queries with $1, $2, ... (query_params / execute_params) over string interpolation to stay injection-safe.
For a query run many times with different parameters, call prepare(sql) once, then query_prepared(stmt, params) to reuse the compiled plan.
Query results are returned as JSON (an array of {slug, payload}); decode them on the host side.
Create graph edges with link(from, to, type) (attributes via link_meta) and traverse them with graph queries.
Call compact() after heavy writes to flush the WAL, rewrite payloads, and reclaim RAM.
In Dart/Flutter, call `await initSekejap()` once before any database call; the native library is precompiled and bundled, so no Rust toolchain is required.
The Maven coordinate is com.zebflow:sekejap; the pub.dev/npm/PyPI/crates.io package name is sekejap.
